tok 1.0 "Annual audit"

pool company "Company"
  lane coordinator "Audit coordinator"
    start begin "Audit initiated"
    task notify "Send notification to the regional office"
  lane regional "Regional office"
    and split
    task prepare "Prepare financial statements and gather documents"
    and joined
    task submit "Submit the documents to the central audit team"
    task clarify "Provide clarifications"
  lane compliance "Compliance team"
    task updates "Check regulatory updates"
  lane audit "Central audit team"
    xor reviewIn
    task review "Review the submission"
    xor issues "Discrepancies found?"
    task request "Request clarifications from the regional office"
    task assess "Conduct risk assessment"
    and riskSplit
    task fin "Evaluate financial risks"
    task oper "Evaluate operational risks"
    task comp "Evaluate compliance risks"
    and riskJoin
    xor high "High risk identified?"
    task analysis "Analyse data"
    task interviews "Conduct interviews"
    xor site "Site visit needed?"
    task visit "Conduct site visit"
    xor siteEnd
    xor riskEnd
    task compile "Compile the audit report"
    xor reportIn
    task update "Update the report"
  lane director "Audit director"
    task approveReview "Review the report"
    xor approved "Report approved?"
    and distSplit
    task distribute "Distribute the final report to the executive board"
    task archive "Archive the final report"
    and distJoin
    end done "Audit process closed"

flow begin -> notify -> split
flow split -> prepare -> joined
flow split -> updates -> joined
flow joined -> submit -> reviewIn -> review -> issues
flow issues -> request "yes"
flow request -> clarify -> reviewIn

flow assess -> riskSplit

flow riskSplit -> oper -> riskJoin
flow riskSplit -> comp -> riskJoin
flow riskJoin -> high
flow high -> analysis "yes"
flow analysis -> interviews -> site
flow site -> visit "yes"
flow visit -> siteEnd
flow site -> siteEnd "no"
flow siteEnd -> riskEnd
flow high -> riskEnd "no"
flow riskEnd -> reportIn -> compile
flow compile -> approveReview
flow approveReview -> approved
flow approved -> update "no"
flow update -> approveReview
flow approved -> distSplit "yes"
flow distSplit -> distribute -> distJoin
flow distSplit -> archive -> distJoin
flow distJoin -> done
